question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: 'Jealous'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the paragraph, we have discussed the **life of Shakespeare**.
 
• Only option 2 which is **Jealous** best suits the line: "**One jealous writer-Robert Greene-wrote rude things about this newcomer and referred to him as an 'upstart crow' **".
 
• The **emotion** is discussed in this line.
 
• **Jealousy** is one such emotion in which a **person says bad things about the other person**.** **

**​****The correct sentence__**: *One **jealous** writer-Robert Greene-wrote rude things about this newcomer and referred to him as an 'upstart crow'.*​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• ​The word **inferior** means **'lower in position.'**
 
• ​The word **rude** means **'****offensively impolite or bad-mannered'**.
